title: The Motivational Paradox: How Aspirational-Goal Communications Influence Sales Performance and Information Acquisition
eligible_reason: Field experiment across stores in Sweden: treatment-group agents receive aspirational-goal text messages starting on one common date (date 919, i.e., Sept 19; pre period Aug 22-Sept 18, treatment period Sept 19-Oct 16). Table 5 regresses outcomes on treatgroup x treatperiod split by four performance tiers (u1-u4, subgroup-by-treatment interactions) with date and employee FE. Single adoption date (not staggered), tier interactions, IV in appendix; data simulated.
design_notes: Replication_AspirationalGoals.do Table 5: regress y u1 u2 u3 u4 i.date i.emp, vce(cluster bch), u_k = treatgroup*treatperiod*tier_k. Checked Sdata_simulated.csv: treatperiod==1 exactly for date 919-1016 for every unit; 183 treated and 245 control agents. Appendix Tables A2-A5 add SPM/work-hours regressors and ivreg2.
data_files_note: Original data under NDA; shipped file is simulated from the estimated model parameters.
data_provenance_note: Readme: 'the package uses simulated data generated from the model parameters estimated in the paper.'
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
